key_insight: SA-508 Grade 3 Class 2 and Type XM-19 are high-strength candidates for SMR pressure vessels, but each requires further welding and material qualification.
engineering_relevance: Pressure-vessel application depends on suitable filler metals, irradiation-resistant base and weld metals, and scalable manufacturing.
method: Review material specifications and application status.
Assess filler metal development needs for both steels.
Identify irradiation, forging, and weld-performance qualification gaps.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a review of specifications and development needs, without reporting quantitative test results.
watch_item: Key gaps are SA-508 irradiation-embrittlement evaluation for beltline service and XM-19 large-forging capability and weld verification under reactor conditions.
paper_title: High-Strength Steels and Welding Filler Metals for Small Modular Reactor Pressure Vessels
